notes_blind_original: SCORE push-button attempt: 'Completed claim(s): none'. The shipped script (SHA matches the pin) uses interactive file.choose(), calls functions since renamed in SemNetCleaner/SemNeT (partboot, partboot.test), and calls autoDeStr(binary, ...) where the object is 'bin'. The analyst skipped the first 30 lines, loaded Cleaning File.Rdata, renamed functions and copied old helpers from GitHub. No set.seed anywhere, and partboot uses cores=4. The analyst also notes 'even with setting a seed the outcome can be different each time'. Some Table 3 cells fall outside SCORE's approximate band despite the analyst's boilerplate line (CC 70%: 27.995 vs 36.38; ASPL 50%: -16.306 vs -12.27; ASPL 60%: -23.439 vs -20.01; CC 50%: 17.927 vs 21.71). The likely causes are package versions and the unseeded bootstrap. C6 is the main judgement call (see rationale). The claim list has no problems, and its reported values match the manuscript.
